function setRewardsEnable(eanble:boolean)
    for _,rewardItem in ipairs(_rewards) do
        if rewardItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Treasure) then
            ValueHelper:SetValue(rewardItem,TreasureValue.enable,eanble)
        elseif rewardItem:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SafeBox) then
            setDoorEnableByRoot(rewardItem,eanble)
        elseif ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(rewardItem) then
            ValueHelper:SetValue(rewardItem,DragItemValue.enable,eanble)
        end
    end
end

function openSafeBox()
    AudioHelper:PlayEffect("打开保险箱")
    for _,safeBox in ipairs(_rewards) do
        if safeBox:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.SafeBox) then
            setDoorOpenByRoot(safeBox,true)
            local ItemPoint:Attachment = safeBox:FindFirstChild("ItemPoint",true)
            -- 创建道具
            local randomId = safeBox:GetAttribute("RandomId")
            ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemsByRandomId(randomId,ItemPoint.WorldCFrame.Position)
        end
    end
end

function upLevel()
    local newLevel = _level + 1
    local newLos = ConfigHelper:Get(GemTowerSetting,GemTowerSetting.k.lv,newLevel,true)
    if newLos and #newLos then
        _level = newLevel
        _los = newLos
    end
end

function checkNextWave()
    if #_enemyParent:GetChildren() > 0 then return end

    _wave += 1
    if _wave > #_los then
        changeState(STATE.result)
    else
        -- 创建敌人
        print(string.format("宝石塔刷新第%d波敌人，共%d波",_wave,#_los))
        local r = 5
        local lo = _los[_wave]
        local enemyIds = lo.enemyIds:split(",")
        local att:Attachment = _towerController:FindFirstChild("刷怪点"):FindFirstChild(tostring(_wave))
        for _,enemyIdStr in ipairs(enemyIds) do
            local enemyId = tonumber(enemyIdStr)
            local enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,_enemyParent)
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),0,math.random(-r,r))
            enemy:PivotTo(att.WorldCFrame + offset)
        end
    end
end

function changeState(state:number)
    if _state == state then return end
    _state = state

    _TriggerPart.CanTouch = _state == STATE.free
    t_time.Visible = _state == STATE.cd
    if _state == STATE.free then
        -- 1.启动大门
        -- 2.重置小门
        upLevel()
        createReward()
        setDoorEnableByRoot(enterDoor,true)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(door1,false)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(door2,false)

        _wave = 0
        _cd = 0
        print("宝石塔已就绪")
    elseif _state == STATE.fighting then
        print("宝石塔战斗开始")
        _bgm:Play()
    elseif _state == STATE.result then
        print("宝石塔结算")
        setRewardsEnable(true)
        openSafeBox()
        local tipsText = "The challenge has been completed. The timer will reset in 180 seconds. Please collect your rewards as soon as possible."
        UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients(tipsText,UIHelper.TipsStyle.Event)
        task.delay(180,function()
            if _state == STATE.result then
                changeState(STATE.cd)
            end
        end)

        GameHelper.onGemTowerComplete:Fire()

    elseif _state == STATE.cd then
        _bgm:Stop()
        -- 1.关闭大门
        print("宝石塔冷却")
        setDoorEnableByRoot(enterDoor,false)
        setDoorOpenByRoot(enterDoor,false)
        _cd = 1200
        -- _cd = 60
        t_time.Text = string.format("💎 %s refresh",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(_cd))
    end
end

function setDoorOpenByRoot(doorRoot:Model,isOpen:boolean)
    for _,door in ipairs(doorRoot:GetChildren()) do
        if door:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor) then
            GameHelper:SetDoorOpen(door,isOpen)
        end
    end
end

function setDoorEnableByRoot(doorRoot:Model,enable:boolean)
    for _,door in ipairs(doorRoot:GetChildren()) do
        if door:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameDoor) then
            GameHelper:SetDoorEnable(door,enable)
        end
    end
end

init()
_TriggerPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart)
    if not CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.Player) then return end
    if _state ~= STATE.free then return end
    changeState(STATE.fighting)
end)
GameHelper.SetGemTowerCD.Event:Connect(function(cd:number)
    _cd = cd
end)

    local dt = task.wait(1)

    if _state == STATE.cd then
        _cd -= dt
        t_time.Text = string.format("💎 %s refresh",CommonFunc:TimeToStrAuto(_cd))
        if _cd <= 0 then
            -- 启动塔
            changeState(STATE.free)
        end
    elseif _state == STATE.fighting then
        checkNextWave()
    end
end"},{"id":320,"text":"local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))

function onTagAdded(door:Model,connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    if GameHelper:IsPrefab(door) then return end
    local rootPart:Part = door.PrimaryPart or door:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
    local DoorPart:Part = door:FindFirstChild("DoorPart")
    local closeCFrame:CFrame = DoorPart:GetPivot()
    local openAtt:Attachment = rootPart:FindFirstChild("Open")
    local ProximityPrompt:ProximityPrompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
    ProximityPrompt.ActionText = "Open"
    ProximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance = 5
    ProximityPrompt.Parent = DoorPart

    if door:GetAttribute("Enable") == nil then
        door:SetAttribute("Enable",true)
    end
    local open = function()
        ProximityPrompt.Enabled = false
        DoorPart:PivotTo(openAtt.WorldCFrame)
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("Door",DoorPart)
    end

    local close = function()
        ProximityPrompt.Enabled = door:GetAttribute("Enable")
        DoorPart:PivotTo(closeCFrame)
    end

    local onEnableChanged = function()
        local enable = door:GetAttribute("Enable")
        if enable and not GameHelper:GetDoorOpen(door) then
            ProximityPrompt.Enabled = enable
        end
    end

    onEnableChanged()
    door:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOpen"):Connect(function()
        local isOpen = door:GetAttribute("IsOpen")
        if isOpen then
            open()
        else
            close()
        end
    end)

    door:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Enable"):Connect(onEnableChanged)
    ProximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(playerWhoTriggered)
        GameHelper:SetDoorOpen(door,true)
    end)
end

local MAX_GROUND_DISTANCE = 175

local _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal:{boolean} = {}
local _groundAnimals:{Model} = {}

math.randomseed(tick())
-- 生成鳄鱼/野猪/火鸡
function trySpawnLittleTurkey(ground:Part,gridPoint:Vector3)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.land  then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if zoneLevel ~= 3 then return end

    local enemyId = 110
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= 10
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal

    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
end

GameHelper.GroundSpawnEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,ground:Instance)
    local gridPoint = GameHelper:ValidateGroundSpawnRequest(player,ground,MAX_GROUND_DISTANCE)
    if not gridPoint then return end

    trySpawnLittleTurkey(ground,gridPoint)
end)"},{"id":322,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

function onTagAdded(lamp:Tool, connections:{RBXScriptConnection})
    local v_isLight:BoolValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("isLight")
    local v_Oil:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("Oil")
    local v_OilMax:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("OilMax")
    local SpotLight:SpotLight = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpotLight",true)
    local Beam:Beam = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Beam",true)
    local Burning:Sound = lamp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound",true)
    if Burning then
        Burning.Looped = true
    end

    local b_fill:ImageLabel = lamp:FindFirstChild("b_fill",true)

    -- 保暖功能
    local v_warmValue:NumberValue = lamp:FindFirstChild("每秒降低寒冷值")
    local warmValue = 0
    if v_warmValue then
        warmValue = v_warmValue.Value
    end

    local player:Player = nil

    SpotLight.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
    Beam.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
    local onOilChanged = function()
        local rate = math.clamp(v_Oil.Value / v_OilMax.Value,0,1)
        b_fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(rate,1)

        if v_Oil.Value <= 0 then
            v_isLight.Value = false
        end
    end

    local onIsLightChanged = function()
        SpotLight.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
        Beam.Enabled = v_isLight.Value
        if Burning then
            if v_isLight.Value then
                Burning:Play()
            else
                Burning:Stop()
            end
        end

        if player and player.Character then
            local character = player.Character
            if warmValue > 0 then
                if v_isLight.Value then
                    character:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
                else
                    character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    onOilChanged()
    onIsLightChanged()
    table.insert(connections,v_Oil.Changed:Connect(onOilChanged))
    table.insert(connections,v_isLight.Changed:Connect(onIsLightChanged))
    table.insert(connections,lamp.Activated:Connect(function()
        if v_Oil.Value > 0 then
            v_isLight.Value = not v_isLight.Value
        else
            v_isLight.Value = false
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections,lamp.Equipped:Connect(function()
        player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(lamp.Parent)
        if not player then return end

        onOilChanged()
        onIsLightChanged()
    end))
    table.insert(connections,lamp.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        if player and player.Character then
            local character = player.Character
            character:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.WarnLampBuff)
        end

        if Burning then
            Burning:Stop()
        end

        player = nil
    end))

    table.insert(connections,lamp.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
        if parent then
            if not parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.GameBackpack) and not parent:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Player) then
                v_isLight.Value = false
            end
        end
    end))

    local nextHBTime = 0
    table.insert(connections,RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if workspace.DistributedGameTime < nextHBTime then return end
        nextHBTime = workspace.DistributedGameTime + 1

        if v_isLight.Value and player and player.Character then
            v_Oil.Value = math.max(v_Oil.Value - 1,0)

            if warmValue > 0 then
                -- 升温
                GameHelper:PlayerAddFreezeMeter(player,-warmValue)
            end
        end
    end))
end

    for _,ghost in ipairs(ghosts) do

        if not ghost:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost) then continue end
        GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player,ghost,lightDamage,GameEnum.DamageSource.Light)
    end
end)"},{"id":323,"text":"local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local SteamWeaponHeatService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("SteamWeaponHeatService"))

local GunValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GunValue

local STEAM_WEAPON = {
	[614] = {
		range = 120,
		heat = 28,
		overheatDuration = 3,
		effectType = "SteamBurst",
		blastRadius = 12,
		blastDamage = 55,
		maxBlastTargets = 6,
	},
	[615] = {
		range = 300,
		heat = 72,
		overheatDuration = 4,
		effectType = "SteamPierce",
		maxPierceTargets = 4,
		pierceRadius = 2,
	},
}

local lastGunFireAt = {}
local lastGunShotToken = {}

local function getFireOrigin(player:Player, gun:Tool)
	local firePoint = gun:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
	if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("Attachment") then
		return firePoint.WorldPosition
	end
	if firePoint and firePoint:IsA("BasePart") then
		return firePoint.Position
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return rootPart and rootPart.Position
end

local function isFiniteVector3(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
		and value.X == value.X and value.Y == value.Y and value.Z == value.Z
		and math.abs(value.X) < math.huge and math.abs(value.Y) < math.huge and math.abs(value.Z) < math.huge
end

local function createRaycastParams(character:Model)
	local filter = {character}
	for _, fog in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog)) do
		table.insert(filter, fog)
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
	return params, filter
end

local function dealNpcDamage(player:Player, npc:Model, hitPart:BasePart?, baseDamage:number, direction:Vector3, hitPosition:Vector3?, shotToken:number?)
	local damage = baseDamage
	local isHeadshot = hitPart ~= nil and hitPart.Name == "Head"
	if isHeadshot then
		damage *= 2
	end

	local applied = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, damage, nil, {
		HitPosition = hitPosition,
		HitDirection = direction,
		IsCritical = isHeadshot,
		ShotToken = shotToken,
		RangedWeapon = true,
	})
	if not applied then
		return false
	end

	if isHeadshot then
		GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc, direction)
	end
	GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, damage)
	return true
end

local function applyBlastKnockback(npc:Model, blastPosition:Vector3)
	if not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) or npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.EnemyBoss) then
		return
	end
	local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
	if not rootPart or not rootPart:IsA("BasePart") or rootPart.Anchored then
		return
	end
	local offset = rootPart.Position - blastPosition
	if offset.Magnitude <= 0.01 then
		return
	end
	local impulseDirection = offset.Unit * 8 + Vector3.yAxis * 2
	rootPart:ApplyImpulse(impulseDirection * rootPart.AssemblyMass)
end

local function fireVisualNearby(shooter:Player, gun:Tool, visualOrigin:Vector3, endPosition:Vector3, effectData)
	for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local rootPart = otherPlayer.Character and otherPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local inRange = false
		if rootPart then
			local delta = rootPart.Position - visualOrigin
			inRange = delta:Dot(delta) <= 250 * 250
		end
		if otherPlayer == shooter or inRange then
			GameHelper.CharacterGunFireS2C:FireClient(otherPlayer, gun, endPosition, effectData)
		end
	end
end

local function fireSteamBurst(player:Player, gun:Tool, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, config, damage:number, shotToken:number?)
	local raycastParams = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.range, raycastParams)
	local endPosition = result and result.Position or origin + direction * config.range
	local effectData = {
		EffectType = config.effectType,
		ImpactPosition = nil,
		BlastRadius = config.blastRadius,
		HitPositions = {},
	}

	if result then
		effectData.ImpactPosition = result.Position
		local isNpc, directNpc = GameHelper:IsNPC(result.Instance)
		if isNpc then
			dealNpcDamage(player, directNpc, result.Instance, damage, direction, result.Position, shotToken)
		end

		local candidates = GameHelper:NPCCollect(result.Position, config.blastRadius)
		local blastRaycastParams, blastFilter = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
		for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
			table.insert(blastFilter, candidate)
		end
		if directNpc then
			table.insert(blastFilter, directNpc)
		end
		blastRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = blastFilter

		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
			return (a:GetPivot().Position - result.Position).Magnitude < (b:GetPivot().Position - result.Position).Magnitude
		end)

		local blastOrigin = result.Position + result.Normal * 0.08
		local damagedTargets = 0
		for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
			if npc == directNpc or not npc:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy) then
				continue
			end
			local humanoid = npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				continue
			end

			local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
			local targetPosition = rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") and rootPart.Position or npc:GetPivot().Position
			local blocked = workspace:Raycast(blastOrigin, targetPosition - blastOrigin, blastRaycastParams)
			if blocked then
				continue
			end

			if GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, config.blastDamage, GameEnum.DamageSource.Explosion, {
				HitPosition = targetPosition,
				HitDirection = direction,
				SuppressHitReaction = true,
				ShotToken = shotToken,
				RangedWeapon = true,
			}) then
				GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, config.blastDamage)
				applyBlastKnockback(npc, result.Position)
				table.insert(effectData.HitPositions, targetPosition)
				damagedTargets += 1
				if damagedTargets >= config.maxBlastTargets then
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, endPosition, effectData)
	return endPosition
end

local function getPierceTargetPosition(npc:Model)
	local rootPart = npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or npc.PrimaryPart
	if rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return rootPart.Position
	end
	return npc:GetPivot().Position
end

local function getPrecisePierceHit(npc:Model, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, maxDistance:number)
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {npc}
	return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * maxDistance, params)
end

local function fireSteamPierce(player:Player, gun:Tool, origin:Vector3, direction:Vector3, config, damage:number, shotToken:number?)
	local corridorRadius = config.pierceRadius
	local corridorCenter = origin + direction * (config.range * 0.5)
	local corridorCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(corridorCenter, corridorCenter + direction)
	local candidates = GameHelper:NPCCollectInBox(corridorCFrame, Vector3.new(corridorRadius * 2, corridorRadius * 2, config.range))

	local terminalParams, terminalFilter = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
		table.insert(terminalFilter, npc)
	end
	terminalParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = terminalFilter

	local terminalResult = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * config.range, terminalParams)
	local endPosition = terminalResult and terminalResult.Position or origin + direction * config.range
	local terminalDistance = terminalResult and terminalResult.Distance or config.range

	local orderedCandidates = {}
	for _, npc in ipairs(candidates) do
		local targetPosition = getPierceTargetPosition(npc)
		local distanceAlong = (targetPosition - origin):Dot(direction)
		if distanceAlong >= 0 and distanceAlong <= terminalDistance then
			table.insert(orderedCandidates, {
				npc = npc,
				distance = distanceAlong,
				position = targetPosition,
			})
		end
	end
	table.sort(orderedCandidates, function(a, b)
		return a.distance < b.distance
	end)

	local hitPositions = {}
	local piercedTargets = 0
	for _, candidate in ipairs(orderedCandidates) do
		if piercedTargets >= config.maxPierceTargets then
			break
		end

		local exactResult = getPrecisePierceHit(candidate.npc, origin, direction, terminalDistance)
		local hitPart = exactResult and exactResult.Instance or nil
		local hitPosition = exactResult and exactResult.Position or candidate.position
		if dealNpcDamage(player, candidate.npc, hitPart, damage, direction, hitPosition, shotToken) then
			piercedTargets += 1
			table.insert(hitPositions, candidate.position)
		end
	end

	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, endPosition, {
		EffectType = config.effectType,
		ImpactPosition = endPosition,
		PierceRadius = corridorRadius,
		HitPositions = hitPositions,
	})
	return endPosition
end

function reload(player:Player)
	local gun:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
	if not gun or not gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then return end
	if SteamWeaponHeatService:IsSteamWeapon(gun) and not SteamWeaponHeatService:CanUse(player) then
		return
	end

	local configFolder = gun:FindFirstChild("配置")
	if not configFolder then return end

	local v_reloading:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.reloading)
	local c_reloadNum:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("装填子弹数量")
	local c_reloadCD:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("装填时长")
	local v_bulletAmount:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.bulletAmount)
	if not v_reloading or not c_reloadNum or not c_reloadCD or not v_bulletAmount or v_reloading.Value then
		return
	end

	local gunItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(gun)
	if not gunItemLo then return end
	local bulletItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(tonumber(gunItemLo.param))
	if not bulletItemLo then return end
	local v_playerBullet:IntValue = GameHelper:GetCurBulletValue(player, bulletItemLo.ItemType)
	if v_playerBullet.Value <= 0 then
		AudioHelper:CallClientPlaySound(player, "Empty Gun Sound")
		UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player, "Insufficient ammunition!", UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
		return
	end
	if v_bulletAmount.Value == c_reloadNum.Value then return end

	v_reloading.Value = true
	local reloadNum = c_reloadNum.Value - v_bulletAmount.Value
	local cost = math.min(v_playerBullet.Value, reloadNum)
	v_playerBullet.Value -= cost
	task.wait(c_reloadCD.Value)
	if not gun.Parent then return end
	v_reloading.Value = false
	v_bulletAmount.Value += cost
end

GameHelper.CharacterGunFireC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player, hit:BasePart, requestedEndPosition:Vector3, shotToken:number?)
	local gun:Tool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(player)
	if not gun or not gun:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then return false end

	local configFolder = gun:FindFirstChild("配置")
	if not configFolder then return false end

	local c_damage:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("伤害")
	local c_shotCD:NumberValue = configFolder:FindFirstChild("发射间隔")
	local v_reloading:BoolValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.reloading)
	local v_bulletAmount:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(gun, GunValue.bulletAmount)
	if not c_damage or not c_shotCD or not v_reloading or not v_bulletAmount or v_reloading.Value then
		return false
	end

	local weaponId = SteamWeaponHeatService:GetWeaponId(gun)
	local steamConfig = STEAM_WEAPON[weaponId]
	local origin
	local direction

	if not GameHelper:isAlive(player) or not isFiniteVector3(requestedEndPosition) then
		return false
	end
	origin = getFireOrigin(player, gun)
	local rootPart = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not origin or not rootPart or (origin - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 12 then
		return false
	end
	local aimVector = requestedEndPosition - origin
	if aimVector.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
		return false
	end
	direction = aimVector.Unit

	local timeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if type(shotToken) == "number" then
		local tokenRecord = lastGunShotToken[player]
		if tokenRecord and tokenRecord.token == shotToken and timeNow - tokenRecord.time < 6 then
			return false
		end
	end
	local previousFireAt = lastGunFireAt[player] or 0
	if timeNow - previousFireAt < math.max(0.05, c_shotCD.Value * 0.9) then
		return false
	end
	if steamConfig and not SteamWeaponHeatService:CanUse(player) then
		return false
	end
	lastGunFireAt[player] = timeNow
	if type(shotToken) == "number" then
		lastGunShotToken[player] = {token = shotToken, time = timeNow}
	end

	if v_bulletAmount.Value <= 0 then
		reload(player)
		return false
	end

	local costBullet = 1
	if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.FreeBulletV1) and math.random(1, 10) == 1 then
		costBullet = 0
	end
	v_bulletAmount.Value -= costBullet

	if steamConfig then
		local actualEndPosition
		if weaponId == 614 then
			actualEndPosition = fireSteamBurst(player, gun, origin, direction, steamConfig, c_damage.Value, shotToken)
		else
			actualEndPosition = fireSteamPierce(player, gun, origin, direction, steamConfig, c_damage.Value, shotToken)
		end
		SteamWeaponHeatService:AddHeat(player, steamConfig.heat, steamConfig.overheatDuration)
		return true, actualEndPosition
	end

	local raycastParams = createRaycastParams(player.Character)
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * 100, raycastParams)
	local actualHit = result and result.Instance or nil
	local actualEndPosition = result and result.Position or origin + direction * 100
	local isNpc, npc = GameHelper:IsNPC(actualHit)
	if isNpc then
		local damage = c_damage.Value
		local isCritical = actualHit.Name == "Head"
		if isCritical then
			damage *= 2
		end
		local applied = GameHelper:NPCTakeDamage(player, npc, damage, nil, {
			HitPosition = actualEndPosition,
			HitDirection = direction,
			IsCritical = isCritical,
			ShotToken = shotToken,
			RangedWeapon = true,
		})
		if applied then
			if isCritical then
				GameHelper:PlayHeadShotFlyHat(npc, direction)
			end
			GameHelper.onPlayerAttackHitNpc:Fire(player, npc, damage)
		end
	end
	fireVisualNearby(player, gun, origin, actualEndPosition, {HitCharacter = isNpc == true})
	return true, actualEndPosition
end

function setFireEnable(enable:boolean)
    local BillboardGui:BillboardGui = UIPart.BillboardGui
    local Icon:BillboardGui = UIPart.Icon
    local lastEnable = campfire:GetAttribute("EnableFire")
    if lastEnable ~= nil and lastEnable == enable then
        return
    end

    campfire:SetAttribute("EnableFire", enable)
    for _,child:Instance in ipairs(campfire:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            child.Enabled = enable
        elseif child:IsA("Fire") then
            child.Enabled = enable
        end
    end

    PointLight.Enabled = enable
    Icon.Enabled = enable
    BillboardGui.Enabled = enable
    if enable then
        FireBurning:Play()
    else
        FireBurning:Stop()
    end

    Range:PivotTo(enable and RootPart.CFrame or RootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,-100,0))

    -- 营火模型替换

    campfireModel:PivotTo(campfireModel:GetPivot().Rotation + campFirePos)
    campfireModel.Parent = campfire

    local touchPart:BasePart = campfireModel:FindFirstChild("TouchPart")

        _touchPart.CFrame = touchPart.CFrame

    v_baseRange.Value = campfireLo.baseRange
    v_heat.Value = campfireLo.startHeat

    onRangeChanged()
    RefreshAirWall()

    if level > 1 then
        local nextCampfireLo = MapHelper:GetCampfireLo(level + 1)
        if nextCampfireLo then
            -- 提示营火升级
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("The fire has reached 100% intensity, and the map has expanded.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Event)
        else
            UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients("The fire has reached 100% intensity and the map has been expanded to its maximum size.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Event)

        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("营地升级")

            GameHelper:AwardGem(player,amount,GameEnum.SourceType.CampfireLvUp)

    local Outside:Attachment = campfireModel:FindFirstChild("Outside")
    if Outside then
        local pos = MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(Outside.WorldCFrame.Position)+Vector3.new(0,4,0)
        local movedObject = {}
        local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
        overlapParams:AddToFilter(campfireModel)

        local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(touchPart.CFrame,touchPart.Size * 1.1,overlapParams)
        for _,hit:BasePart in ipairs(hits) do
            local model:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.DragItem)

function RefreshAirWall()
    if #_levelWalls <= 0 then
        local parent = Instance.new("Model")
        parent.Name = "空气墙"
        parent.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
        parent:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.zero))
        parent.Parent = workspace

        local prefab:Part = workspace.Prefabs.Map:FindFirstChild("区域格挡空气墙")

        local wallStartPos = Vector3.new(-(prefab.Size.X * wallCount / 2) + prefab.Size.X / 2,0,0)
                -- print(wallCount)
        for i=1,4 do
            local rootPart:Part = Instance.new("Part")
            rootPart.Name = string.format("空气墙%d", i)
            rootPart.Size = Vector3.one
            rootPart.Transparency = 1
            rootPart.CastShadow = false
            rootPart.Anchored = true
            rootPart.CanCollide = false
            rootPart.CanTouch = false
            rootPart.CanQuery = false
            rootPart:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
            rootPart.Parent = parent
            table.insert(_levelWalls, rootPart)
            
            for j = 1,wallCount do
                local wall = prefab:Clone()
                wall.Anchored = false
                wall:PivotTo(CFrame.new(wallStartPos + Vector3.new((j-1) * prefab.Size.X,0,0)))
                CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(rootPart,wall)
                wall.Parent = rootPart
            end
        end
    end

    local wallT = _levelWalls[1]
    local wallB = _levelWalls[2]
    local wallL = _levelWalls[3]
    local wallR = _levelWalls[4]

    local gridSize = MapHelper.gridSize_1 * MapHelper.gridSize_2

    -- local length = distance * 2 + 10
    -- print("空气墙距离",distance)
    -- local originPosition = campfire:GetPivot().Position
    local originPosition = Vector3.zero
    -- 上
    -- wallT.Size = Vector3.new(length, 200, 10)
    -- wallT.Position = Vector3.new(0,0,-distance) + originPosition
    wallT:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,0,-distance) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 下
    -- wallB.Size = wallT.Size
    -- wallB.Position = Vector3.new(0,0,distance) + originPosition
    wallB:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,0,distance) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 左
    -- wallL.Size = Vector3.new(10, 200, length)
    -- wallL.Rotation = Vector3.new(0,90,0) -- 旋转90度
    -- wallL.Position = Vector3.new(-distance,0,0) + originPosition
    wallL:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(-distance,0,0) + originPosition,originPosition))
    -- 右
    -- wallR.Size = wallL.Size
    -- wallR.Rotation = Vector3.new(0,90,0) -- 旋转90度
    -- wallR.Position = Vector3.new(distance,0,0) + originPosition
    wallR:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(distance,0,0) + originPosition,originPosition))

function updateGoldParts(parts:{Part},count:number,prefab:Part)
    local max = math.max(#parts,count)
    for i=1,max do
        local part = parts[i]
        if i <= count then
            if not part then
                part = prefab:Clone()
                part.CFrame = prefab.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,(i-1) * prefab.Size.Y,0)
                part.Name = string.format("金条_%d",i)
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanTouch = false
                part.CanQuery = false
                part.Anchored = true
                part.Parent = prefab.Parent
                parts[i] = part
            end
            part.Transparency = 0
        else
            if part then
                part.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end
